text: here is a performance problem for you to chase right now. the quality slider in the context menu make the entire app eat fucking shit. its probably a javascript slider. if so, i shouldnt have to say any more and the fix should be obvious. if there are others that exist inside of the @cart/editor/ cart specifically better fix them before i find them
resolution: Fixed the Quality slider perf meltdown. Root cause: the slider fired host.__model_set_quality — a full mesh re-decimation from the retained full-res source — on EVERY onChange frame (~60x/sec throttled to 16ms) while dragging. Since the host Slider (SLIDER-0611) already owns the thumb during a drag and ignores sliderValue echoes mid-drag, onChange gave zero UX benefit and only produced a re-mesh storm that melted the app. Fix: dropped onChange from both quality sliders (cart/editor/stage/ModelContextMenu.tsx and the standalone cart/modelview.tsx strip) and kept onCommit, so decimation runs exactly once on release. Thumb still scrubs smoothly host-side; the tris readout settles on release. Audited every other slider/onChange in cart/editor: the rest are cheap text inputs (search/rename) and MaterialFocus quality is discrete onPress buttons — no other per-frame heavy handlers exist.
